name: Shoujo Tantei Rinn-chan no Jikenbo - Dennou Shoujo Densetsu
original_name: 少女探偵ＲＩＮＮちゃんの事件簿 電脳少女伝説
source:
Medieval fantasy world. Sister Norico accidentally got a curse item and turned into an evil witch. Rinn-chan learned the secrets of sex from a mysterious Chinese person, got a special sword of the fox from an alchemist of Central Europe and set to challenge Noriko's demonic dungeon.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在中世纪奇幻世界。姐姐纪子意外得到一件受诅咒的物品，变成了邪恶魔女。少女侦探凛从一名神秘中国人那里学到性爱奥秘，又从中欧炼金术士手中获得一把特殊的狐剑，随后动身挑战纪子的魔窟。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
